capabilities: Manage collection status (Wishlist, Active, Done, etc.)
Import data from external services (Goodreads, Letterboxd)
Query and filter entries across multiple ledgers
problem: Users need a way to track large personal collections of books and movies without cluttering their vault with individual notes for every single item.
summary: A ledger-based system for tracking books and movies, allowing entries to live in a single note rather than requiring a separate file for every title.
